hose-adapter.title: Hose Adapter
hose-adapter.summary: Custom transition between vacuum hose and tool diameters.
hose-adapter.description: Utility part printed on demand to mate hose and nozzle with controlled clearance. Validated in daily use with PETG for heat and impact resistance.

filament-rack.title: Filament Rack
filament-rack.summary: Modular organizer for spools on the workbench.
filament-rack.description: Modular frame that keeps spools aligned and labeled. Designed to grow by modules and fit narrow shelves.

desk-organizer.title: Desk Organizer
desk-organizer.summary: Compartments for pens, SD cards, and tool bits.
desk-organizer.description: Workbench piece with a clean silhouette and internal dividers. Balances function and presence in a maker setup.

gearbox-proto.title: Gearbox Prototype
gearbox-proto.summary: Fast validation of clearances and shaft alignment.
gearbox-proto.description: Functional prototype to check meshing and noise before a final batch. Rapid PETG iterations with reused metal shafts.

drone-mount.title: Drone Camera Mount
drone-mount.summary: Lightweight mount with damping and quick access.
drone-mount.description: Mechanical part for securing an action cam with controlled vibration. Prioritizes local stiffness and low mass.

flexible-gasket.title: Flexible TPU Gasket
flexible-gasket.summary: Elastic seal for enclosure and cable entry.
flexible-gasket.description: 95A TPU gasket printed to seal an improvised enclosure. Improves on hand-cut seals with better repeatability.

tabletop-mini.title: Tabletop Miniature
tabletop-mini.description: Decorative miniature printed at low layer height to preserve relief. Minimal post-processing.

lamp-shade.title: Lamp Shade
lamp-shade.summary: Diffuser whose layer pattern filters light.
lamp-shade.description: Semi-open shade that turns layer lines into luminous texture. Designed for low-power LEDs.
